summary: Full Stack Engineer specializing in React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, with proven experience building scalable, data-driven platforms. projects.title: VidyaSetu - AI Powered Student Intelligence Platform | Next.js, Node.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL

projects.title: ReplyPilot AI | React, FastAPI, Supabase PostgreSQL, LangGraph
